verdict.rationale: SolidJS's own README points users to an official playground where example code can be run ('Try this code in our playground!'), so runnable examples exist. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference. Community hands-on reports of a misbehaving landing-page playground widget and of site examples failing to load on Android Chrome show the runnable examples have rough edges, but they don't refute that the playground exists. Missing for 10: a documented interactive API reference, runnable examples embedded per API entry, reliable cross-device behaviour, and independent positive corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
